source:packages/dashpanel/src/runtime/pa.head: e466825985740c3f4d6c4fa42e9ffd8910c5fd98
source:packages/dashpanel/src/runtime/pa.reason: New nullable public dockPreview observes existing Hybrid pointer intent and target-proxy viewport bounds without altering committed layout, shortcut lifecycle or value binding. Public controller/decision/consumer documentation and delivered typed example cover the addition. All 78 focused runtime/controller/drag/public-consumer tests, workspace formatting/lint/types, 5 packaging policy tests and the existing real placement browser journey pass, including active Escape, target changes, leave, drop, occupied-zone and mode eligibility with no preview persistence writes. The two existing guides and all three planning documents still accurately cover their bounded shortcut/binding tasks; dock-preview observation does not change those recommendations. Fresh immutable installed-consumer verification follows at release.
